items.text: Search "biotechnology salary" and you will find one site claiming Rs 3 LPA, another claiming Rs 24 lakhs average, and a third somewhere in between.

items.heading: The Same Job Title
items.text: The same job title on the same salary platform can pay noticeably differently depending on the city, because biotech-company density, cost of living, and competition for skilled people are not equal across India.

items.heading: Entry
items.text: Entry-adjacent clinical operations role. Roughly Rs 1.8-4.5 LPA - the common first foothold, often not yet titled "CRA.".

items.heading: Cra I / Junior Cra
items.text: CRA I / Junior CRA. Roughly Rs 3.5-6.5 LPA once you carry the actual Clinical Research Associate title.

items.heading: Cra Ii / Senior Cra
items.text: CRA II / Senior CRA (3-6 years). Roughly Rs 8-14 LPA, where independent site-management responsibility grows.

items.heading: Lead Cra / Clinical Trial
items.text: Lead CRA / Clinical Trial Manager. Roughly Rs 16-22 LPA, running multiple sites or a full trial.
